service.name: Jazz band for a wedding
service.serviceType: Jazz band for wedding ceremonies, cocktail hours, dinners and receptions in Colorado
service.description: A jazz band for a Colorado wedding, sized to each part of the day: a solo jazz guitarist or a duo for the ceremony, upright bass and guitar through the cocktail hour, a trio with brushes through dinner, and a quartet with a horn or a voice for the first dance and the floor, on one contract with sound included, across Denver, the Front Range and the mountain towns.

faqs.q: Can we hire a jazz band for a wedding ceremony?
faqs.a: Yes, at the size a ceremony wants, which is one or two musicians. A solo jazz guitarist or the duo plays the prelude while guests arrive, the processional, and the recessional, through a small system that also carries the officiant's microphone. The same musicians walk to the terrace and play the cocktail hour, so the ceremony and the hour after it are one booking.

faqs.q: Which size of jazz band does a wedding reception need?
faqs.a: It follows the floor. Dinner wants the trio, drums played with brushes, at a level the tables talk across. A first dance and an open floor want the quartet, the trio plus a horn or a voice, and a ballroom of two hundred wants the quartet with a singer out front. Tell us the guest count and the venue and we'll recommend the size.

faqs.q: How much does a jazz band cost for a wedding?
faqs.a: It depends on how many musicians play and for how long, and the market figures for a duo, a trio and a quartet are set out, sourced, in what a jazz band costs in Denver. We publish no prices of our own. Send the date and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price for that day.

faqs.q: Can the same jazz band play the whole wedding?
faqs.a: Yes, and that is the usual way to book it. The duo plays the ceremony and the cocktail hour, the drummer joins for dinner, the horn or the singer joins for the floor, and the DJ carries the late end through the same sound system. One contract, one load-in, one sound check, and the guests hear one band getting bigger.

faqs.q: Will a jazz band play our first dance?
faqs.a: Yes. If the song is a standard, it's already in the book. If it isn't, the first learned song is included in every booking, so send the title with the date and it's ready for the day.

faqs.q: Is a jazz band the right choice for a wedding that wants dancing?
faqs.a: For a floor that wants to dance to the songs it knows, a jazz quartet plays the swing and the soul side of the standards book and hands off to the DJ for the late end. For a floor that wants pop and rock all night, book a covers band for the reception and keep the jazz for the ceremony, the cocktail hour and dinner, on the same contract.
